## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed feature

What you would like z-agent to do.

## User type

- IBM Z learner
- Mainframe developer
- DevOps engineer
- Operations team
- Support team
- Other:

## IBM Z / Zowe relevance

How does this relate to IBM Z and/or Zowe/zOSMF? (z-agent builds on Zowe and
does not replace it.)

## Safety / audit impact

- Does this introduce any action that modifies IBM Z? (Yes / No)
- If yes, which safety mode should govern it?
- Does it require an audit log entry? If so, what action type?
- Does it involve AI analysis of sensitive data? If so, how should it be
  masked?

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you considered solving the problem.

## Notes

Any additional context. Do not include secrets, credentials, or real
production spool/SMF data.
